<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that handlers lose hours to phone calls instead of processing claims or managing reserves. I checked the five most similar items: bulk document upload (4127, completed) addresses document handling, not phone-call burden; task list improvements (4134, in progress) and Task overview cover task prioritization, not call reduction; Claims timeline is a progress-tracking view; Supplier address fields is unrelated.
